pf.license.need: Optional, and Rosie checks nothing. The clinic may list each clinician's license or credential and its own registration; Rosie shows what the clinic enters, as given.
pf.license.ask: Optional: each clinician's license or credential and its end date, as the clinic keeps them.
pf.license.who holds it: The clinic; each clinician; each health coach.
pf.license.how it's checked: Rosie does not check, look up or verify any license, registration or credential (D96). The clinic's own word only.
pf.license.blocks going live: None for a license: nothing is held back because a credential is not on the page.
pf.license.renewals: None tracked by Rosie; the clinic keeps its own dates.
pf.license.insurance or bond: Optional: the clinic may list its liability insurance; Rosie does not check it.
pf.license.background check: The clinic's own choice; Rosie does not run one.
pf.license.own word: If the clinic says a visit needs a credential a person doesn't have, that person isn't offered that visit (the clinic's own word, not a check).

pf.services.shape: Weight-loss clinic: a first visit with a clinician for a weight-care plan, follow-up visits, and health-coach visits; in person at the clinic, by video where the clinician is licensed where the patient is during the visit, and at home in a few places.
pf.services.examples: The example clinic's own self-pay prices, not a standard. Plans rarely pay for weight care here; a self-pay price is the default.

pf.safety.medical questions: Never answered: what a medicine does, whether a diet or a drug is right, or what a test means. Those go to the clinician. Rosie never gives weight, diet or medicine advice.

required.name: Intake form

required.name: Health history and medicines

required.name: Doctor's note (where the clinic asks for one)

pf.first_steps.prep for the reminder: On a secure link: what to bring (a photo ID, the medicine list, the plan card), and what to wear for the body check.
pf.first_steps.prep timing: Usually none for a weight visit. A blood test, if ordered, may need fasting from the night before; that prep is on the secure link.

pf.visit.check-in: The check-in code at the front desk. A video visit: the code is read out at the start.
pf.visit.at the visit: The clinician checks the intake form and the health history before any plan. A chaperone is offered for a body check.
pf.visit.work changes: A plan change (a new medicine or a new test) comes only from the clinician; the desk never adds a test on its own.
pf.visit.stops: A pregnancy, a flag the clinician won't clear, or a missed fast for a blood test: the visit doesn't go ahead; another time, with no fee.
pf.visit.what proves it's done: The code, or DONE when the visit ends.
pf.visit.results: Lab results and the clinician's notes stay in the clinic's own records and portal. Rosie never texts a result or a weight.

pf.money.before: Nothing taken at booking (the starting answer). No card is saved unless the owner turns on the no-show fee.
pf.money.after: At the clinic: paid at the front desk after the visit, card or cash, the clinic's own way. At home: one bill from Rosie after the visit, with the trip fee in it; a plan's share billed by the clinic its own way.
pf.money.fees: A no-show or a late cancel within 24 hours: $40, only if the owner says yes, and only where a card was saved at booking.
pf.money.rosfield: Rosfield's $2 per booking applies as for every business (D97); the clinic pays it, never the client.

pf.messages.never in a text: The weight, the plan, the medicine, the test, the reason for the visit, and any health or eating history. Texts name only the clinic, the date, the time, the place and a secure link; staff and owner texts use initials.
pf.messages.results: Never in a text; 'your clinician has the report' at most, only where the client agreed.
pf.messages.languages: English and Spanish, plus the clinic's interpreter line.
pf.messages.minors: A parent or guardian books; texts go to them.

pf.staff.roles: Clinicians (physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, as licensed), health coaches, and the front desk.
pf.staff.supervision: A medicine decision is the clinician's alone; a coach gives no medical advice.
pf.staff.skills: each person's visit kinds, as the clinic lists them
pf.staff.who OKs: The clinician OKs every plan and any flag; a coach doesn't.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Another clinician or coach with the same skill. A client who asked for a woman or a man is asked before anyone else is booked; nobody moves on silence.
pf.staff.chaperone: Offered for every body check; a client's request is honored.

pf.rules.orders: No weight-care plan without the intake form and the health history; a medicine change needs the clinician's own order.
pf.rules.health privacy: The clinic signs Rosie's health-privacy agreement before going live.
pf.rules.eating: A visit never books a restrictive plan for someone with signs of an eating disorder (see the safety rules).
pf.rules.results: Lab results and notes go to the client through the clinic's own portal; Rosie never carries them.
pf.rules.records: Records kept as long as the state's rules require, in the clinic's own system; a client's copy within 30 days.
pf.rules.minors: Who may consent for a teen, and what a teen may consent to alone: from the state's form, as the clinic's own rule.
pf.rules.video: A video visit only where the clinician is licensed where the client is during the visit.

matter most.no intake form on the day: The desk calls; no form, no visit, no fee.
matter most.a flag the clinician won't clear: The visit moves to a call with the clinician, with no fee.
matter most.could be pregnant: Stopped until the clinician OKs it.
matter most.eating-disorder signs: No booking; the clinic's own line, a doctor, 988 and 911.

pf.edges.the rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.

Dietitian's own steps (referral licensing, follow-up booking, covered hours) are not carried over.
